The `sum()` function adds up the numbers in a collection. `cumsum()` does something similar. 

```{webr}
numbers <- c(6, 4, 8, 2, 1)
sum(numbers)
cumsum(numbers)
```

Explain in everyday English what `cumsum()` does.

`r devoirs_text("agb-cumsum")`

:::
